top rclive_tb.shbench for Ngspice
== rcfilter.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  doc "RC low-pass section: R from in to out, C from out to gnd (live Virtuoso kit fixture)"
  prefix X

pin in in -40 0
pin out out 40 0
pin gnd inout 0 40

param R 1k
  unit Ohm
param C 1u
  unit F

impl sch schematic

rect -20 -20 20 20

line -40 0 -20 0
line 20 0 40 0
line 0 20 0 40

stext -20 -28 R0 {name}
  size 0.2
stext -14 -5 R0 rc
  size 0.18

inst c00001 core:cap
  at 0 90 R0
  name C1
  value C
inst r00001 core:res
  at 0 0 R0
  name R1
  value R

wire w00001 -60 -30 0 -30
wire w00002 0 30 0 60
wire w00003 0 30 60 30
wire w00004 0 120 0 150

port p00001 -60 -30 R0 in
port p00002 60 30 R180 out
port p00003 0 150 R270 gnd
== rclive_tb.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  doc "RC step response for the live Virtuoso kit: OCEAN must give tau = R*C and v(out) at 1 ms = 1 - 1/e"

inst v00001 core:vsource
  at -120 30 R0
  name V1
  value "PULSE(0 1 0 1n 1n 10m 20m)"
inst x00001 ./rcfilter
  at 0 0 R0
  name X1
  R R
  C C

wire w00001 -120 0 -40 0
wire w00002 -120 60 -120 80
wire w00003 0 40 0 80
wire w00004 -120 80 0 80
wire w00005 40 0 80 0

label n00001 80 0 R0 out
label n00002 -80 0 R0 in
label n00003 -60 80 R0 0

var R 1k
  unit Ohm
var C 1u
  unit F

output tau "cross(v(out), 0.6321205588285577)"
output v1m "at(v(out), 1m)"

spec v1m
  min 0.5
  max 0.8

code tran spice
  | .tran 1u 5m
== schemify.project
schemify 1 project
